say:4:1711137004:1.text: The Black Gold Guild's forbidden spell... and the heavy price to pay?
say:4:1711137004:1.source_cn: 黑金商会的禁咒……还有惨重的代价？

say:6:1711137006:1.text: Well then, as per the rules, one piece of information leads to one question. What would you like to know this time?
say:6:1711137006:1.source_cn: 那么，按照规矩，一个情报换一个问题。阁下这次想知道什么呢？

choice_prompt:9:1711137008.text: Oh? That's quite an unexpected question. Could it be that the great Lord Merlin has finally recovered from his mental lapse and remembered his past?
choice_prompt:9:1711137008.source_cn: 哦？真是令人意外的问题。难道说，伟大的梅林阁下终于治好了脑子，想起了曾经的过往？

say:10:1711137009:1.text: That's such a shame. I thought it would save me a lot of trouble in rebuilding trust.
say:10:1711137009:1.source_cn: 那真是太遗憾了，在下还以为能省去许多重新建立信任的麻烦呢。

say:11:1711137011:1.text: Since your memory is incomplete, please forgive me for not being able to provide any further information.
say:11:1711137011:1.source_cn: 既然阁下的记忆并不完整，那请恕在下无可奉告。

choice_prompt:12:1711137011.text: Since your memory is incomplete, please forgive me for not being able to provide any further information.
choice_prompt:12:1711137011.source_cn: 既然阁下的记忆并不完整，那请恕在下无可奉告。

say:14:1711137013:1.text: Since it's intelligence, it can't be given away for free.
say:14:1711137013:1.source_cn: 既然是情报，自然不能免费赠送。

choice_prompt:16:1711137014.text: ...This guy is a real swindler; he even charges for catching up. It seems we can't get anything out of his past relationship; I'd better just ask directly.
choice_prompt:16:1711137014.source_cn: ……这个家伙真是一个奸商，连叙旧都要收钱。过往关系看来试探不出什么，还是直接发问吧。

say:19:1711137016:1.source_cn: 这句话……真是令在下感到意外……

say:20:1711137017:1.text: To be honest, I thought you had completely forgotten about it and would never mention it again.
say:20:1711137017:1.source_cn: 老实说，我还以为您已经彻底忘记，永远不会提起此事了。

choice_prompt:24:1711137020.text: In contrast, your current expression, which carries a hint of helplessness, makes you seem more humane.
choice_prompt:24:1711137020.source_cn: 相比之下，现在这种带着点无可奈何的表情，倒是让阁下显得更有人情味了一些。

say:25:1711137021:1.text: You are overthinking it. I have kept your items safe and sound, and they are in perfect condition.
say:25:1711137021:1.source_cn: 阁下多虑了。您要的东西，在下一直好好地收着，毫发无损。

choice:24:0:1.text: Stop trying to get close to me. Is the item still there?
choice:24:0:1.source_cn: 少套近乎，东西还在不在？

choice:9:0:1.source_cn: 并没有，我还是一头雾水

say:27:1711137010:1.text: Oh? Just a fragment? What a pity.
say:27:1711137010:1.source_cn: 哦？仅仅是片段吗？真是可惜。
